queries.name: runtime_database_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, @@SERVERNAME AS server_name

queries.name: servidores_conexiones_schema
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'Servidores_Conexiones' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: api_local_connections_safe_scope
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 100 CONVERT(nvarchar(100), id) AS connection_id, name AS nombre_conexion, tipo_conexion, activo, EmpresaID, visible_en_operaciones FROM dbo.Servidores_Conexiones WHERE tipo_conexion = 'API_LOCAL' ORDER BY name

queries.name: rbac_schema_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Permis%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Rol%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Usuario%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Permis%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Rol%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Usuario%' ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: empresa_scope_schema_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Empresa%' OR COLUMN_NAME IN ('EmpresaID', 'UsuarioID') ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION

objective: Audit EDARSAHUB SQL canonical RBAC and EmpresaID scope for Servidores API connections. Classify why UI test-connectivity returns 'Sin permiso para acceder a esta conexion API'.
